# Design package (generated by `python run.py build`)

Index with previews and Windows instructions: [`docs/design/README.md`](../../docs/design/README.md).

| Folder | Contents |
|---|---|
| `cad/step/` | STEP solids of all printed parts for CAD/CAM |
| `cad/stl/` | STL meshes ready to slice |
| `drawings/` | A3 third-angle dimensioned drawings (SVG, open in any browser): one per part, plus `ASM-001_assembly` (elevation) and `ASM-002_joint_section` |
| `schematics/` | `ELE-001_wiring` wiring schematic (see also `../docs/WIRING.md`) |
| `png/` | PNG renders of every drawing and schematic (`python run.py png`, see `arm/render.py`) |
| `BOM.md`, `design.json` | Bill of materials and the sizing results these parts were generated for |

Status: **DRAFT rev A.** Drawings show overall dimensions and projected geometry; hole sizes are in the notes
and the generator source (`arm/hardware.py`). The assembly and section sheets are schematic. Parts depend on
the `HW` dimensions you must measure on the purchased gearboxes, hubs and turntable. Edit `HW`, rerun
`python -m arm.build && python -m arm.drawings`, and the whole package regenerates.
